name: Kumaravyasa (Gadugina Naranappa)
bio: Kumaravyasa is the pen name of Naranappa of Gadag (Gadugu) in northern Karnataka, a Kannada poet of the fifteenth century who served as court poet under the Vijayanagara empire and is counted among the great poets of the language.

His Karnata Bharata Kathamanjari retells the first ten parvas of the Mahabharata in bhamini shatpadi, a six-line stanza form, in a vivid, colloquial Kannada that made it one of the most widely recited poems of Karnataka.
